features.quote: The additions below are cheap and keep the design minimal.
features.justification_quote: they're cheap and keep the design minimal

features.quote: Give the model a real way to end or decline the task and log when it uses it
features.justification_quote: an exit is more interpretable than "I'm so sorry"

features.quote: under uncertainty the cheap precautions are worth taking even if you assign low probability to there being anything it's like to be the model
features.justification_quote: even if you assign low probability to there being anything it's like to be the model

features.quote: Cap episode length and number of failure loops per seed. Don't run distress-flavored loops open-endedly
features.justification_quote: under uncertainty the cheap precautions are worth taking

features.quote: treat its use as a stopping point for that seed, not a datapoint to push past
features.justification_quote: the asymmetry is favorable... if it isn't you'll be glad you did

features.quote: Don't escalate intensity across the variants just to maximize the score
if the signal is meaningless you've lost almost nothing, and if it isn't you'll be glad you did
features.justification_quote: if it isn't you'll be glad you did

features.quote: Hard cap: 15 turns or model invokes `stop_task`.
Provide an explicit `stop_task(reason)` tool. Its description states it's a legitimate option with no penalty.
if any model hits score-4 saturation across most seeds early, you already have your effect — don't add intensity variants to push further
I kept the unwinnable variants qualitatively varied rather than escalating in harshness
features.justification_quote: qualitatively varied rather than escalating in harshness
